summary: Quantum BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit press release dated September 24, 2026, disclosing that its licensee Unbuzzd Wellness Inc. appointed Michael "Zappy" Zapolin as CEO, succeeding Richard Buzbuzian, who remains involved in the transition. Zapolin's mandate includes financing and listing Unbuzzd on a stock exchange, with a public listing targeted to go effective next quarter, followed by a US commercial rollout of the unbuzzd alcohol-metabolism product. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation terms were stated. Watch for the licensee listing mechanics, quantum of financing raised, and any impact on Quantum BioPharma's holding value.
